issue.symptom: Typing after a native mouse click loses its prefix and gains the current page URL while the input is still focused.

reproduction.method: Real isolated Xvfb pointer click from native website focus; existing matching history row; one keyboard character every 140ms across the 100ms Places debounce.

issue.cause: When query results became empty, LocationBar requested hiding the popup. Main echoed location-overlay:hidden; the renderer treated that as blur/cancel, set editing=false, and synchronized the draft with the committed URL. Later keystrokes appended to the overwritten value.
issue.fix: Renderer-requested popup hides and window-resize hides suppress the native cancellation notification. Main still hides/removes the dropdown and invalidates pending shows. Input draft/caret/composition remain owned by the renderer; native cancellation routes retain their existing notifications.

coverage: Native mouse routing from live-page focus selects the current address.
Slow typing through matching to empty results retains the whole query, input focus and end caret.
Home-key insertion retains the prefix and typed suffix.
Typing the origin again reopens the matching native dropdown.
Korean composition and committed text survive the next empty result.
Explicit Escape restores the committed page URL.
Existing split-video, pointer selection, keyboard and IME scenarios remain included.

previewContract.display: Isolated Xvfb; private runtime/D-Bus; inherited Wayland sockets removed

setupFailures.cause: The seeded /second bookmark did not match the complete /first address initially searched. The fixture was corrected to seed the current URL.

Playwright locator elements required an explicit HTMLInputElement type for value/selection access. Fixed without changing runtime assertions. Subsequent GUI execution from that shell used the old build and is not candidate validation.
A native title update renamed the bookmarked row from the fixture label to Research page. The test now identifies the row by its stable URL while preserving all input/focus/caret/IME assertions.

limits: The regression uses real Chromium IME composition via CDP, rather than a desktop IBus candidate window.
Latency measurements cover ordinary Markdown and Git transitions, not Places-query latency.
Source/build updated; separately installed desktop app not replaced.

benchmark.harness: candidate; same tests for both apps; five cycles per fresh process
benchmark.measurement: Escape keydown to latest-content nonempty native capture; includes polling/IPC/readback, not monitor presentation
